herdr-git-status.desc: herdr sidebar git-status poller (feeds the $git metadata token)
herdr-git-status.note: self-exports a full PATH, so the minimal supervisor env still resolves herdr/gitmux/jq

herdr-sysinfo.desc: herdr sidebar system-info feeder (feeds the $sys metadata token)
herdr-sysinfo.note: linux runs the shebang directly and pins format via env; macOS forces system python3 and relies on script defaults

herdr-agent-activity.desc: herdr agent-activity ($act sidebar token: per-agent last-activity age)

herdr-thread-status.desc: herdr thread-status ($pr sidebar token: PR approvals + CI state)
herdr-thread-status.note: needs an authenticated gh on PATH; unauthenticated just means the token never appears

herdr-pane-summary.desc: herdr pane-summary (label agent panes from their AI session title)

herdr-focus-tracker.desc: herdr focus-tracker (MRU state for last-pane / last-tab / last-workspace jumps)

herdr-balance-panes.desc: herdr balance-panes (even split ratios after every pane create/close)
